verdicts.reason: Both have the same structural flaws. The 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow drops below the headline and the fine print, which breaks the reading order. The 'Ends Sunday. Online only.' fine print is raised above the eyebrow and leaves 'only.' orphaned on its own line. There is also a large dead gap around the product and below the CTA. A is slightly worse: the headline's 'off' sits tighter against the decorative circle, and the Shop Sale button runs almost edge to edge with about 6px margins. B moves the headline clear of the circle and insets the button with even side margins.
